data.turoyo: W koqodar d ʕobar b kul əskimo, lə kmiʕayar ebe.
data.translation: And he can go about in any attire; he is not ashamed of it.

rationale: Third Detransitive Infectum example; negative shame with b-attire contrasts with inherited people/manner stimuli. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.

summary: No R1 job. The token fits the inherited Detransitive shame sense of homonym ʕyr 2, not adjustment ʕyr 1 or active mockery.

The experiencer is the subject of k-miʕayar; ebe introduces the stimulus. Detransitive filing here does not imply an external person shaming him, and negation does not establish a new shamelessness sense.
Kleidung/Auftreten ist b-markierter Anlass der Scham; keine neue Bedeutung gegenüber Personen/Verhalten in den vorhandenen Beispielen.
